evidence_items.title: zhaochenyang20/full-duplex-bench
evidence_items.summary: Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 and v1.5 archives Byte-identical copies of the Full-Duplex-Bench v1.0 and v1.5 archives from the official Google Drive folder of Full-Duplex-Bench. They are kept here so that automated benchmark runs can fetch them from the Hugging Face Hub instead of Google Drive, which refuses downloads once a file has had too many accesses. The CANDOR subsets of v1.0 (candor_pause_handling, candor_turn_taking) are not in this repository. evidence_items.title: Kling-Keye-Official/VideoRover-Bench
evidence_items.summary: Thinking Beyond Videos: Unifying Video Reasoning and Deep Research for Open-World Video Agents Illustration of how VideoRover unifies Thinking-with-Videos and Deep Research for open-world video questions. While the first two separately localize video evidence or retrieve external knowledge, VideoRover maintains a shared research state to adaptively coordinate video cropping, text and image search, and webpage browsing toward the final answer.
